draft_stages.name: exploratory / partial
draft_stages.implication: Structure only. No line-level findings at all — the prose isn't real yet.

draft_stages.name: first complete draft
draft_stages.implication: Developmental focus. Line findings only if major+ or a manuscript-wide pattern.

draft_stages.name: revised
draft_stages.implication: Both layers in full, normal severity calibration.

draft_stages.name: near-submission
draft_stages.implication: Both layers, and minor findings become worth reporting.
